name: Graphite
css: .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: var(--docent-shadow); } .popover .arrow { border-color: transparent !important; } .ring { box-shadow: 6px 6px 16px oklch(13% 0.008 260 / 0.8), -6px -6px 16px oklch(39% 0.01 260 / 0.5); } .eyebrow { color: var(--docent-accent); } .button { border-radius: 12px; } .button:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--docent-accent); } .button.primary { padding-inline: 16px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 10px oklch(13% 0.008 260 / 0.8), -4px -4px 10px oklch(39% 0.01 260 / 0.45); } .button.primary:hover { background: var(--docent-accent); color: var(--docent-accent-fg); } .button.primary:active { scale: 1; box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 7px oklch(50% 0.1 165 / 0.6), inset -3px -3px 7px oklch(92% 0.1 165 / 0.6); } .close { border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 7px oklch(13% 0.008 260 / 0.7), -3px -3px 7px oklch(39% 0.01 260 / 0.45); } .close:hover { background: transparent; } .marks i { height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(20% 0.008 260); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 1px oklch(13% 0.008 260); } .marks i[data-done] { background: var(--docent-accent); box-shadow: none; }
